node.statement: This corrected child is the dependency-bearing proof of the parent step. It depends on node 1.2 and requires node 1.2 to be validated; node 1.2 supplies exactly r_star in C. Since D = dist_1(p,C) is the infimum of ||p-y||_1 over all y in C, substituting the validated member y = r_star gives D <= ||p-r_star||_1.
